invariants.text: A booking must have a valid guest_id that corresponds to an existing guest in the system.
A booking must have a valid room_id that corresponds to an existing room in the system.
A booking must not overlap with another existing booking for the same room during the check-in to check-out period.
A booking status must be set to 'confirmed' only after the room and guest details are validated and the booking period is non-overlapping.
A guest must be uniquely identified by their first name, last name, and email, and cannot be duplicated with the same combination.
A room's availability status must be updated to 'booked' during the check-in to check-out period and back to 'available' after the check-out date.
Booking.guest_id must reference an existing Guest.id
Booking.id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
Booking.room_id must reference an existing Room.id
Guest.id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
If a room is booked for a period, it cannot be booked again for the same room during overlapping dates.
Room.id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
